description: Convert HTML to tidy markdown ($0.005 USDC via x402). Pass html (string) and/or url (public https to fetch). At least one required; if both, prefers html and warns. URL fetches use the same allowlist as WELL-002 (https only — http/file/data/localhost/private IPs rejected; 1 MB body, ~10s timeout, max 5 redirects). Returns JSON { source, url?, final_url?, content_type?, markdown, warnings }. As is, no warranty. Nothing stored.

html.description: HTML string to convert to markdown. Preferred when both html and url are set.

url.description: https URL to fetch HTML from and convert. http/file/data/localhost/private IPs rejected.

name: html-to-markdown
